title: Seminaire de Geometrie Algebrique (SGA): English Translation Working Drafts
description:
Public SGA working-translation record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This version preserves the existing reader-facing PDFs, source-scan witnesses, and repair/source ZIPs while adding one compact SGA5 repair032 audit-support bundle: SGA5_repair032_audit_support_20260624.zip.

Status at a glance. This is a substantial working-draft and repair record, not a globally certified complete edition and not a critical edition. The SGA5 material is explicitly not complete and should be assumed to contain many remaining errors unless a later, narrower source-audit packet promotes a specific locus.

Current SGA5 audit caveat. A newer manual certification log demotes the agent/workflow passes to finder status rather than certification status. The latest observed local CERT_LOG now supersedes the earlier p93/p94/p100/p102 cursors: pp.1-108 are page-locally hand-certified; pp.1-72 close Expose I; pp.73-108 cover Expose III through Theoreme 4.4, including the Lefschetz cup-product, correspondence-pairing construction (4.2.1)-(4.2.5), D039 cube, D040 main square, and D001-D060 hand-verified perfect through p108; the earlier p98 source-typo fix remains the only substantive Expose III fix recorded in the certified p73-p108 range; p109 is next. The broader local SGA5 live workpass remains important repair evidence: it reports 411 verified corrections, p1-p484 page-by-page French source-audit coverage in the live status note, and a 307-page PDF with no fatal/LaTeX-error diagnostics in the latest observed log scan. Remaining SGA5 publication/audit work includes final diff/FINDINGS refresh, compact packaging, independent validation, optional low-value prose-fidelity review where desired, and English synchronization. The p69 scope note clarifies that the source scan is the full 484-page LNM 589, but the local TeX is a curated 10-expose selection (I, III, IIIB, V, VI, VII, VIII, X, XII, XV); current pp.1-108 certification is opening-range evidence, not global SGA5 certification. This proves that diagram errors and prose/symbol/functor-level errors remain in older global drafts and outside hand-certified loci. The current agent scorecard is useful but cautionary: in the hand-certified opening range it records 28 verified correct fixes, 1 partial/notation-imperfect fix, 9 misses, 0 false positives, and 0 botched fixes; it also records D001-D013 as hand-verified perfect while flagging that diagram-index page estimates can drift by about three pages in the D001 case, so diagram-batch clean reports are locator evidence rather than certification, with p13 and p37 showing that agents may catch real local errors while failing to propagate the exact source notation across parallel occurrences.

New file in this version. SGA5_repair032_audit_support_20260624.zip bundles the local repair032 final packet, p205-p226 microaudit packet, remaining-error web-drop, README, and checksum manifest. The bundle is included so the current local repair/audit evidence is preserved in one slot on a record already at Zenodo file-count pressure.

File-surface curation note. The SGA record is at Zenodo's 100-file ceiling. This version removes the obsolete tiny sga_repair019_public_summary.json file from the latest file surface in order to add the repair032 audit-support bundle. Earlier versions preserve previous files.

Filename warning. Older filenames containing words such as Complete, Strict, Source-Checked, or High-Fidelity are legacy package names and are not current global certification claims. Source-witness and aid ZIPs are locator/check layers, not textual authority by themselves. Treat SGA6 and SGA7 as substantial working drafts with explicit compression/source-check caveats unless a specific later packet declares source-checked coverage.

Corrections and contributions. Source comparisons, LaTeX fixes, translation corrections, and reader-facing issue reports can be suggested through the GitHub mirror via issues or pull requests: https://github.com/KokunoYumeto/modern-latex-manuscripts.
